status: FROZEN, RUN (result: NO GAIN ON THIS LAYER)
question: does the adopted diversity-first admission produce higher asserted world-edge coverage than the reference engine on the same real world, at the same budget and the same number of cycles?

reference.rule: the frozen engine's own builder: transition probability inside a stratified transition/co-occurrence quota, with a schema prior

adopted.rule: the adopted order: fewest already-admitted outgoing edges per source, ties on count then stable key, over the eligible pool

design.world: generate_compositional_world(seed, cycles) -- the Gate 13 world, identical for both arms of a seed
design.endpoint: asserted_coverage from gate_acquisition_sufficiency: the fraction of the world's compositional edges present in the arm's asserted structure (structure_edges over the surviving candidates)
design.pairing: both arms of a seed run on the same generated world; only service_cls differs

seeds.freshness: the first contiguous window of nine integers at or above 20320101 that appears in no file under docs, tests, benchmarks, research-journal or papers; the ninth is the bootstrap seed and is not a world seed

criteria.bar_rule: mean paired coverage difference (adopted minus reference) at or above the bar, interval lower bound above zero, and at least seven of eight seeds with a positive difference
criteria.bar_provenance: carried as policy from the confirmatory block: one half of the order block's measured mean delta, 0.1615, floored to two decimals. It is NOT calibrated on this layer and this block is not a replication of that figure -- the comparison here is a different pair of orderings on a different instrument, and a pass means only that the adopted arm cleared a bar fixed before this run
criteria.guard_rule: mean paired precision difference (adopted minus reference) at or above the guard bar; a failure prices the trade instead of adopting the gain
criteria.guard_provenance: declared, not calibrated: 0.05 is the smallest difference this project's instruments have been asked to distinguish

rules.G0 liveness: the two arms' asserted fingerprints must differ on at least seven of eight seeds, or the manipulation did not occur
rules.G1 world present: raw temporal coverage must be 1.0 in both arms of every seed, or the cell tests memory rather than admission
rules.G2 arithmetic: covered cannot exceed asserted, and coverage and precision must equal covered over their denominators
rules.G3 determinism: the reference arm re-run on the first seed must produce the same asserted fingerprint
rules.G4 denominator: the world must have at least one compositional edge in every seed
rules.G5 boundary: no frozen engine file may differ from HEAD when the block runs

gates.void_rule: a failed gate voids the block and no criterion is read; a cell set that is not the pre-registered grid is refused

decision_table.condition: gates pass; gain passes; guard passes
decision_table.reading: the adopted admission covers more of the world's edges than the reference engine on this world, at the same budget, without losing precision

decision_table.condition: gates pass; gain passes; guard fails
decision_table.reading: coverage rises and precision falls; the trade is recorded and nothing is claimed as a gain

decision_table.condition: gates pass; gain fails; interval width at or below 0.30
decision_table.reading: the adopted rule does not cover more of the world here; the earlier pooled-table gain does not transfer, and this layer is closed to this rule

decision_table.condition: gates pass; gain fails; interval width above 0.30
decision_table.reading: the interval cannot place the difference; absence of a gain is not established
reported as the gate, never as a verdict

allocation.note: two thresholds are fixed here: the gain bar and the precision guard

not_evidence: no behavioural claim: the endpoint is world-edge coverage in the asserted structure, not prediction, revision or retention
one world family and one horizon: the Gate 13 compositional world at 120 cycles
a pass licenses the adoption on this layer only, and the earlier pooled-table figure is not re-used as this block's result
registered_status: FROZEN, NOT RUN (ready; no cell). No arm has run on this registration.

run.reading: the adopted rule does not cover more of the world here; this layer is closed to this rule
run.note: both arms ran on the same generated world for each seed, through the Gate 13 harness; the analysis path ran once, as frozen, and no criterion was re-read

withdrawn.reference: the reference engine (`organica.sleep.SleepService`) is again the only admission path in the package
withdrawn.note: the withdrawal closes the admission question on the engine's prediction layer, in one world family and at one horizon; it does not establish that diversity-first ordering is wrong anywhere else, and the pooled-table gain is neither retracted nor revived
